name: Wonderfull
summary: Studio stile FaceApp: individua i volti, scegli il volto e applica Sorrisi, Impressione, Età, Barbe, Contouring, Capelli e Colori.

source.notes: Wonderfull FaceApp-inspired multi-face studio with face detection, per-face crop & feather blend, and full beauty/expression/age/beard/hair/color categories.

inputs.help: Esalta la bellezza naturale del volto scelto.

inputs.label: Intensità
inputs.default: Use balanced flattering FaceApp retouch intensity (Level 3): visible lighting, skin and color improvement while keeping authentic skin texture, pores and existing facial hair unless beard change was requested.
inputs.help: Livello di intensità del ritocco (1 = leggero, 4 = massimo impatto).

options.value: Use gentle subtle retouch intensity (Level 1): soft natural polish preserving every skin detail.
Use balanced medium retouch intensity (Level 2): clear freshening and clean color.

Use balanced flattering FaceApp retouch intensity (Level 3): visible lighting, skin and color improvement while keeping authentic skin texture, pores and existing facial hair unless beard change was requested.
Use maximum FaceApp glamour intensity (Level 4): bold transformation, strong radiance and vivid punch while keeping recognizable identity.

bind.template: {impression} {smile} {eyes} {age} {beard} {hair_style} {contouring} {color_effect} {intensity} {details} Keep the same recognizable person, exact original skin tone, color temperature, white balance, ambient lighting and shadow intensity, exact camera framing, background, clothing and accessories, with no eyeglasses or sunglasses, completely removing any glasses to show clear unobstructed natural eyes, authentic skin pores and photographic realism.

inputs.help: 8 step consigliati con Lightning 2511 + Portrait LoRA; 10-12 per massima rifinitura su pelle, occhi e denti.
